scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a man waiting to cross the street, with a tall building under construction in the background and a bus driving by in the distance. The man is wearing blue jeans, black shoes, and a backpack, and he is standing on a gray sidewalk next to a pole with a red stop sign and yellow lights. The street has a white crosswalk and a yellow line down the middle, and there are trees and other buildings in the background.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building under construction is covered in scaffolding and has a modern design with large windows. It is taller than the surrounding buildings and has a flat roof.
scene_analysis.materials: The man's backpack is made of dark-colored fabric, and his jeans are a faded blue color. He is also wearing black shoes.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk, as well as a few trees and streetlights.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees are tall and have green leaves, and there are some bushes and flowers along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs along the street, including a red stop sign, a yellow sign with a white arrow, and a blue sign with white text.
scene_analysis.ground_surfaces: The ground is paved with gray concrete, and there are several cracks and potholes.
scene_analysis.spatial_enclosure: The street is relatively wide and has a slight curve to it.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are several people walking along the sidewalk, but they are all blurred due to motion.
scene_analysis.lighting_atmosphere: The lighting is bright and sunny, with a few clouds in the sky.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street is quiet and peaceful, with only a few cars parked along the curb.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: There are several shops and restaurants along the street, including a coffee shop and a bookstore.
